item.title: Justice Department publishes missing Epstein files involving uncorroborated claim about Trump
item.description: The Justice Department has released additional Jeffrey Epstein files involving uncorroborated accusations made by a woman against President Donald Trump that the department said had been mistakenly withheld during an earlier review.

item.title: Utah agency revokes teen treatment facility license after alleged sexual relationship between employee and minor client
item.description: State regulators revoked the license of a St. George Crimson Heights treatment facility, stating in their report that a staff member was arrested in a case involving a sexual relationship with a minor client.

item.title: US aims to exhume and identify the remains of 88 Pearl Harbor dead buried as unknowns
item.description: The U.S. military plans to exhume the remains of 88 sailors and Marines killed when the USS Arizona was bombed during the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in 1941 and who were buried as unknowns in a Honolulu cemetery.

item.title: US employers cut a surprising 92,000 jobs last month as unemployment rate rises to 4.4%
item.description: American employers unexpectedly cut 92,000 jobs last month while the unemployment rate went up to 4.4%

item.title: Iran won’t compete at Milan Cortina Paralympics as its only athlete can’t travel safely to Italy
item.description: Iran will not participate in the Milan Cortina Paralympics because its only athlete set to compete can't safely travel to Italy amid the intensifying Middle East conflict, the International Paralympic Committee said Friday.

item.title: Colorado man shot by Utahn after entering home unlawfully, police say
item.description: A man from Colorado allegedly went into a house unlawfully, where he was allegedly shot by a Utahn.

item.title: Russia has provided Iran with information that can help Tehran strike US military, AP sources say
item.description: Russia has provided Iran with information that could help Tehran strike American warships, aircraft and other assets in the region.

item.title: Spacecraft’s impact changed asteroid’s orbit around the sun in a save-the-Earth test, study finds
item.description: A new study has found that an asteroid NASA used for target practice a few years ago was nudged into a slightly different route around the sun.

item.title: Lobbyists plan for long night on last day of Utah legislative session
item.description: The last day of the Utah legislative session brought lobbyists, students, teachers, moms, dads and even photographers to the state capitol building.

item.title: Patriotic quilts fill Garfield County courthouse for America’s 250th celebration
item.description: Over two dozen patriotic quilts filled the hallways of the Garfield County courthouse as residents prepare to celebrate America’s upcoming 250th birthday.
